newsitem.title: USA: Banyan Hotel to be delisted.
newsitem.headline: Banyan Hotel to be delisted.

text.p: Banyan Hotel Investment Fund said on Monday that it had been advised by the American Stock Exchange that its common stock would be removed from listing as the company no longer meets necessary requirements.
Banyan also said it had discontinued previously announced negotiations to acquire a portfolio of shopping center retail properties.
Banyan said it unsuccessfully appealed the decision of the American Stock Exchange, which is making application to the SEC to remove Banyan's common stock from listing.
The company said the final day for trading will be Friday, October 25. Banyan said it anticipates that a market for its common stock may develop on the over the counter market.
